- **bars_v1.png**: Liquidity and solvency risk by regime and scenario, version 1. The absolute crisis flag is 100% in high_debt by construction (starting GFN above the threshold); the hurricane-attributable flag (GFN > no-hurricane baseline + margin) separates regimes. Simulated, N=10,000 paths, T=30 yrs, seed 42, common random numbers across regimes. ALL parameters are PLACEHOLDER_VERIFY (unsourced).

- **heatmap_barbados_style_v1.png**: Clause benefit, Barbados-style clause, version 1. The debt axis varies the fiscal stance jointly (primary balance interpolated between the two scenarios), so it is a vulnerability gradient, not a pure debt gradient. Positive = clause helps. Grey 'n/a' = GFN exceeds GFN_crit with certainty even without the clause (>= 99%), so the absolute-crisis benefit is undefined; panel (b) is informative there. Colour scale winsorized at the 95th percentile; reduction in mean peak GFN (pp of GDP): true max 30.0, min 1.3, colour scale +/-26.4; reduction in P(hurricane-attributable crisis) (pp): true max 4.4, min 0.1, colour scale +/-4.1; reduction in P(GFN > GFN_crit) (pp): true max 3.5, min 0.0, colour scale +/-3.1. Simulated, N=10,000 paths, T=30 yrs, seed 42, common random numbers across regimes. ALL parameters are PLACEHOLDER_VERIFY (unsourced).
